about_the_game:
The main character is a young man who accidentally finds himself in a secluded mansion in the middle of the night. He is rescued from the weather by a mysterious stranger named Eveline. She is beautiful, cold, and inscrutable, and her gaze seems to know more than it should. With each passing minute, the tension between them grows, a mixture of fear, curiosity, and attraction.

But the longer he stays, the more he feels that her words hide not just a secret, but a hunger. A hunger that is impossible to resist.

The night becomes their field of attraction and struggle: between desire and reason, between life and what comes after it.
Now he must decide if he is willing to pay the price for touching eternity.

Game features:
• An atmosphere of gothic romance and secret temptation.
• A story of passion, fear, and the choice between reason and instinct.
• An enigmatic heroine who combines tenderness and danger.
• A combination of mysticism, eroticism, and emotional drama.
• A visual style that conveys the feeling of an old mansion, night, and bloody beauty.
